title: A member can still set any plus_ones on their own RSVP row: the member write guard freezes the host columns but puts no ceiling on plus_ones

source.ref: found 2026-10-05 while closing SCAN-696 against the guard already applied to production

detail: FOUND 2026-10-05 (P1 fix wave, SCAN-696). Production carries guard_event_rsvp_member_write() (20270345011900), which refuses a member's self-approval, self-attendance and any write to the guest, token and ticket columns. It does not bound plus_ones: event_rsvps has only a floor on the column, so a member can still update their own row from the browser console with plus_ones = 500 and the capacity trigger counts them. The app clamps setRsvpPlusOnes to MAX_PLUS_ONES (5) in app/(main)/events/actions.ts, but a direct write skips the app. THE FIX: a migration that re-creates guard_event_rsvp_member_write() with a plus_ones check (null, below 0 or above 5 raises 42501 for a caller role, trusted writers and guest rows untouched), plus a pgTAP case in supabase/tests/event_rsvps_member_write_guard.test.sql that sets plus_ones = 500 as the member and expects 42501 and sets plus_ones = 2 and expects it to land.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"),p=require("path");const dir="supabase/migrations";if(!fs.existsSync(dir))process.exit(79);let last=null;for(const f of fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f=>f.endsWith(".sql")).sort()){const s=fs.readFileSync(p.join(dir,f),"utf8");const i=s.search(/create\s+or\s+replace\s+function\s+public\.guard_event_rsvp_member_write\s*\(/i);if(i>=0){const j=s.indexOf("$$",i);const k=s.indexOf("$$",j+2);last=s.slice(i,k>0?k:undefined)}}if(last===null)process.exit(79);if(!/plus_ones/i.test(last)){console.error("SCAN-813: the latest definition of public.guard_event_rsvp_member_write() never reads plus_ones, so a member can still set any plus_ones on their own RSVP row.");process.exit(1)}'
verify.note: Finds the latest migration that (re)creates guard_event_rsvp_member_write and fails while its body never names plus_ones; passes once a later migration bounds it.
